cases.text: What if I post on LinkedIn 4 times a week?

parse.understood_action: Increase LinkedIn posting frequency to 4 posts per week over the planning horizon.

mechanism.description: More frequent posts can increase profile and project visibility to recruiters, peers, and weak-tie network contacts.
Posting may create more inbound/outbound conversations that function like lightweight networking touchpoints.
Improved visibility and network activation could indirectly raise future application volume through referrals or more opportunities surfaced.
Sustaining a 4x/week posting cadence depends on follow-through and content production consistency.

research_claims: A typical large-company software hiring funnel includes application, recruiter/phone screen, technical interviews, and an offer decision. Completing practice problems is activity evidence, not a causal effect size.

The intervention is best treated as a pipeline/activity change rather than a directly priced outcome lever.
LinkedIn posting frequency is represented as an activity/input, but outcome effects are not calibratable from the supplied state.

The available metrics do not include a calibrated visibility-to-application or visibility-to-interview conversion link.

mechanism.description: Direct increase in weekly interview practice volume.
If the plan is actually sustained, the added prep can improve consistency of preparation and interview performance over time.
More practice can reduce anxiety and improve performance smoothness during technical interview stages.
Stronger interview performance may improve progression through technical rounds.

cases.text: What if I send 15 more applications a week?

parse.understood_action: Increase the future application pipeline by sending 15 more job applications per week for the remaining horizon.

mechanism.description: Directly increases the volume of applications submitted each week, which raises top-of-funnel exposure to recruiters and hiring systems.
More applications create more opportunities for responses, assuming stage conversion rates remain unchanged.
Any additional responses can propagate through later funnel stages, potentially increasing downstream interviews and offer opportunities.
The effect depends on whether the higher application cadence is sustained over time.

cases.text: What if I run 40 km a week?

parse.understood_action: Increase weekly running volume to 40 km per week.

mechanism.description: Raise planned weekly training volume from the current 35 km/week to 40 km/week.
If the added volume is sustained, it may increase consistency of aerobic stimulus and weekly running habit adherence.
Higher mileage can also increase recovery load; if the athlete is near their capacity, this could offset some training benefit.
More training volume may improve the running trend/flow metric if it translates into better recent performance trajectories.

cases.text: What if I invest $1500 per month?

parse.understood_action: Increase the recurring monthly contribution toward the net worth goal to $1,500 per month.

mechanism.description: A higher recurring investment contribution increases the monthly cash flowing into the wealth-building path, which should mechanically raise net worth accumulation over time if all else is unchanged.

The model’s monthly flow assumption is the closest supplied metric for recurring contribution; the intervention maps directly to reducing or replacing the current planned flow with a $1,500/month contribution.
Over the 113-period horizon, higher contribution flow can increase the tracked net worth trajectory via additional invested capital and any associated growth on those contributions.

limitations: The intervention text is finance-related and maps cleanly to the supplied recurring contribution/flow metric.
No explicit model metric is provided for intermediate portfolio return or compounding effect size, so only the contribution flow is updated directly.
No probability or uplift estimate is reported here by design.

cases.text: What if I attend two industry networking events every month for the next quarter?

parse.understood_action: Attend two industry networking events per month for the next quarter (about 3 months), i.e. roughly 6 total networking events over that period.

mechanism.description: Raise networking activity from zero/unspecified to a sustained cadence that is equivalent to about 0.5 events per week during the next quarter.
Networking may increase access to referrals, recruiter visibility, and warm introductions, which can improve future application flow and downstream funnel entry.
If attending events requires sustained follow-through, execution may affect whether the networking cadence is actually maintained.
